The '''1960–61 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]], who finished one point ahead of nearest rival [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]]. [[Clyde F.C.|Clyde]] and [[Ayr United F.C.|Ayr United]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1961–62 Scottish Division Two|1961-62 Second Division]].
